preservation: Restore the original protocol/config/state-security/executables tests in a separate copy. For protocol API adapt only the explicitly changed error-result assertion; for reconnect replace only the old revoked-authorization expectation with the task-required 401 and 403 recovery paths. Preserve every other assertion. New behavior tests are separate.
manualCriteria: Test regression substance and preserved assertions
Patch applies independently of harness and installed runtime runs
Refactoring removes request/retry implementation from CLI into a cohesive library without changing its observable contracts
blinding: Assessment packets use shuffled opaque codes without arm/workflow verdict; source review supplements behavior tests. Internal harness statuses are recorded separately.
claimBoundary: Four diagnostic tasks; no statistical superiority claim and no next series automatically.
